缺氮是下部老叶匀黄、新叶还绿；酸化是根先伤、整株发僵。: Nitrogen shortage yellows old leaves evenly; new leaves stay greener. Acid soil hurts the roots first and the whole plant stalls.
低温回暖会缓；酸化回暖也不长。: Chill eases when it warms; acid soil still will not grow after a warm spell.
旱了浇水能缓；咸了浇小水有时更蔫。白霜是盐的记号。: Drought eases after a watering; salt sometimes wilts more after a light watering. White crust is salt’s calling card.
缺钾土面不一定白；盐害常伴出苗差和白霜。: Potassium shortage does not always show white crust; salt injury often comes with poor emergence and white crust.
旱是没水；板结是有水也进不去。浇下去成径流。: Drought is no water; hard packing is water that cannot get in. It runs off.
整层硬是板结，下面一条发亮硬盖才是犁底层。: The whole layer hard is packing; a shiny hard lid underneath is a plough pan.
缺肥补了当季能绿；家底薄是年年补年年飘。: A this-season shortage greens up after a feed; thin organic matter is feed every year and still thin.
板结是硬；家底薄是没肉，可以又硬又浅。: Hard packing is hard; thin organic matter is no meat in the soil — it can be both hard and shallow.
缺铁黄新叶、叶脉绿；缺氮黄老叶、整叶较匀。: Iron lock: new leaves yellow, veins still green. Nitrogen shortage: old leaves yellow, more even.
涝害白天蔫、根发黑发臭；缺氮根还白。: Waterlogging wilts by day, roots black and smelly; nitrogen shortage still has white roots.
盐害常有白霜、出苗差；缺钾土面不一定白。: Salt injury often has white crust and poor emergence; potassium shortage does not always show white on the surface.
刚施氯化钾还焦，更像氯或盐；缺钾是慢慢来的。: Scorch right after potassium chloride is more chloride or salt; potassium shortage creeps.
缺氮是黄，缺磷是暗绿带紫、发僵。: Nitrogen shortage is yellow; phosphorus shortage is dark green with purple and a stall.
低温也发紫，回暖能缓；缺磷回暖仍僵，酸化田更重。: Chill can purple too and eases when it warms; phosphorus shortage still stalls after a warm spell, worse on acid land.
缺氮黄老叶；缺铁黄新叶、叶脉绿。: Nitrogen shortage yellows old leaves; iron lock yellows new leaves and keeps the veins green.
缺锰常带褐斑；缺铁更干净的脉间黄。: Manganese shortage often has brown specks; iron lock is a cleaner yellow between veins.
药害来得快、跟喷幅重合；缺锌是慢慢缩、连年出现。: Spray injury comes fast and matches the spray bout; zinc shortage creeps and returns year after year.
缺铁主要脉间黄、节间不一定短；缺锌常伴随小叶簇生。: Iron lock is mainly yellow between veins, internodes not always short; zinc shortage often brings little clustered leaves.
缺肥补肥能缓；连作是死棵点片发生，邻地轮作的明显好。: A shortage eases after a feed; same-crop fatigue dies in patches, and the neighbour who rotated looks better.
涝害有明水或土过湿；连作在排水良好棚里也会发生。: Waterlogging has standing water or soil that is too wet; same-crop fatigue still happens in a well-drained house.
露地盐来自地下水或母质；大棚盐多半是肥积出来的。: Open-field salt comes from groundwater or the parent material; greenhouse salt is usually fertiliser that piled up.
缺水土干；盐害浇完更蔫、有白霜。: Dry soil is dry; salt injury wilts more after watering and shows white crust.
旱了浇水能缓；烧根浇小水有时更蔫。: Drought eases after water; burnt roots sometimes wilt more after a light watering.
根腐常点片死棵、有病斑；烧根沿施肥沟整齐发生。: Root rot dies in patches with lesions; root burn lines up along the fertiliser furrow.
缺水土干；涝害土湿还蔫。: Dry-soil wilt sits on dry ground; waterlogging wilts on wet ground.
缺氮老叶匀黄、根还白；涝害根黑臭。: Nitrogen shortage: old leaves even yellow, roots still white. Waterlogging: roots black and smelly.
化验单养分不低却长不好，更像土不活。: The sheet is not low but the crop still fails — more like the soil is not alive.
微生物失衡常和连作一起出现，但先要把有机质和通气搞好，菌才住得下。: A microbe imbalance often rides with same-crop fatigue, but organic matter and air have to be right before any inoculant can live there.
照片只能怀疑，化验单才能大致定量。叶子黄有十种原因。: A photo can only raise a suspicion; the sheet roughly sizes it. Yellow leaves have ten causes.
邻地土不一样。沙土和黏土、酸和碱，用量能差一倍。: The next field is not this field. Sand and clay, acid and alkali — the rate can differ by half.
化验室有差错，但更常见是你挖土的位置不对。: Labs make mistakes; more often you took soil from the wrong spot.
叶子能提示方向，定不了用量。: Leaves can point a direction; they cannot set a rate.
缺钾从老叶缘来；缺钙从顶芽和幼果来。: Potassium shortage starts on old-leaf margins; calcium shortage starts at the growing point and young fruit.
病害会扩展传染、有病斑菌丝；脐腐常同一部位、跟浇水波动同步。: Disease spreads, with lesions or mycelium; blossom-end rot sits on the same spot and tracks watering swings.
缺铁黄新叶；缺镁黄老叶。叶位记错就会补错。: Iron lock yellows new leaves; magnesium yellows old leaves. Get the leaf position wrong and you feed the wrong bag.
缺氮整叶较匀黄；缺镁是脉间黄、叶脉绿。: Nitrogen shortage yellows the whole leaf more evenly; magnesium yellows between green veins.
旱了浇水能缓一部分；花器畸形、空心还在才更像硼。: A watering eases some drought drop; misshapen flowers and hollow hearts that stay are more boron.
毒也焦叶缘、坏死生长点，和缺很像，所以绝不能加倍。: Toxicity also scorches margins and kills the growing point — it looks like shortage, so never double the rate.
缺铁脉绿肉黄、斑点少；缺锰常带褐斑。: Iron lock: green veins, yellow flesh, few spots. Manganese shortage often carries brown specks.
药害喷后1～3天、沿雾滴；缺锰慢慢铺。: Spray injury 1–3 days after the bout, along droplets; manganese shortage spreads slowly.
缺氮老叶先黄心叶还绿；缺硫心叶一起黄。: Nitrogen shortage yellows old leaves first, heart leaves still green; sulphur yellows the heart leaves too.
缺铁脉还绿；缺硫连脉也淡。: Iron lock keeps the veins green; sulphur fades the veins as well.
旱了土干中午蔫；缺铜土不一定干。: Drought wilts at noon on dry soil; copper shortage does not need dry soil.
药害有喷药日、来得快。: Spray injury has a spray date and comes fast.
缺氮老叶匀黄、瘤可能还红；缺钼瘤先没光。: Nitrogen shortage: old leaves even yellow, nodules may still be pink. Molybdenum shortage: nodules go dull first.
铝毒根尖褐秃；缺钼根可以在、瘤不干活。: Aluminium toxicity browns and bares the root tips; molybdenum shortage can keep the roots, but nodules do no work.
单纯缺素化验单对应项低；拮抗是对应项不低甚至极高。: A straight shortage is low on the matching cell; antagonism is not low — sometimes very high.
药害有时间点；拮抗是长期施肥习惯。: Spray injury has a clock; antagonism is a long fertiliser habit.
缺素按叶位慢慢来；药害有明确喷药时间，来得猛。: Nutrient shortage follows leaf position and creeps; spray injury has a clear spray time and hits hard.
病害会扩展传染；药害常与喷幅、行走路线重合。: Disease spreads; spray injury often matches the spray bout and the walking line.
劣种也缺苗，但根尖不一定褐、邻沟不施种肥的却齐。: Poor seed also misses plants, but root tips may not be brown, and the next furrow without starter comes up even.
猝倒有病斑和潮湿；肥害沿施肥沟。: Damping-off has lesions and wet; fertiliser burn lines the furrow.
盐害有土面白霜；氨害有气味和刚施肥史。: Salt injury has white crust; ammonia injury has a smell and a just-applied history.
药害有喷药史；氨害有施肥史和气味。: Spray injury has a spray history; ammonia injury has a fertiliser history and a smell.
缺钾也焦边，但刚施了氯化钾还焦，更像氯或盐。: Potassium also scorches margins, but scorch right after potassium chloride is more chloride or salt.
盐害土面常白；氯害要看肥料种类。: Salt injury often whites the surface; chloride injury depends on the fertiliser kind.
缺水滴灌不够；过浓是浇了更蔫、有盐霜。: Too little drip is dry; too thick wilts more after a watering and shows salt frost.
病害点片死棵；过浓沿滴灌带整齐。: Disease dies in patches; too-thick feed lines up along the drip tape.
腐熟的土温正常、无刺鼻氨味；生粪烫手、刺鼻。: Rotted manure is a normal soil heat with no sharp ammonia; raw dung burns the hand and stings the nose.
病害会传染扩展；生粪伤害集中在施肥穴。: Disease spreads; raw-dung injury sits in the fertiliser hole.
颗粒肥可见粒；返盐是均匀白霜。: Granular fertiliser shows grains; rising salt is an even white crust.
干旱土干无霜或少霜；返盐越浇越白。: Drought is dry with little or no frost; rising salt gets whiter the more you water.
化验单有效铁磷锌低但全量不一定低。: The sheet can show low available iron, phosphorus or zinc while the total is not low.
缺氮老叶黄；石灰性土常见新叶黄。: Nitrogen shortage yellows old leaves; calcareous soil often yellows new leaves.
盐土 EC 高 pH 不一定很高；碱土 pH 高、结构差。: Salty soil is high EC, pH not always very high; alkali soil is high pH and poor structure.
酸土才用石灰；碱土用石灰会更碱。: Lime is for acid soil; lime on alkali soil makes it more alkali.
板结是水进不去；沙土是水留不住。: Hard packing will not let water in; sandy soil will not hold water.
沙土不是绝对没养分，是留不住。: Sandy soil is not empty of nutrient — it will not keep it.
黏土质地是天生的；犁底层是旋耕压出来的。: Clay texture is born with the field; a plough pan is pressed in by rotary tillage.
黏土裂缝宽而深；沙土很少这样裂。: Clay cracks wide and deep; sand rarely cracks like that.
整层都硬是板结；犁底层是下面那一条。: The whole layer hard is packing; the plough pan is the strip underneath.
有的是母质黏盘，深松深度要按当地。: Some fields have a parent-material clay pan. How deep to loosen follows the local advice.
缺肥当季能补；退化是土层和有机质在变薄。: A this-season shortage can be fed; degradation is the layer and the organic matter getting thinner.
东北也有盐碱斑，但黑土退化主要是瘦和薄。: The Northeast has salt patches too, but black-soil decline is mainly thin and poor.
还田抢氮就是一种缺氮，但原因是微生物先吃饭。: Straw stealing nitrogen is one kind of nitrogen shortage — microbes eat first.
带病秸秆会加重土传病，重病田要处理残体。: Diseased straw feeds soil-borne disease. A badly diseased field needs the trash handled.
农用石灰有氧化钙含量；建筑灰杂质多、易烧苗。: Agricultural lime has a calcium-oxide number; building lime is dirty and burns seedlings.
石膏改碱不改酸。白粉不是同一种药。: Gypsum lifts alkali, not acid. White powder is not one medicine.
缺氮根还白；亚铁毒根黑、水锈。: Nitrogen shortage still has white roots; ferrous toxicity has black roots and rusty water.
涝害是缺氧；锈水田常叠加酸和亚铁。: Waterlogging is no air; rusty-water fields often stack acid and ferrous iron.
冷浸田常伴随缺磷，但根因是冷和湿。: Cold-soaked paddies often ride with phosphorus shortage, but the root cause is cold and wet.
病害有病斑扩展；冷浸是全田发僵。: Disease has spreading lesions; cold soak stalls the whole field.
缺肥根不臭；还原障碍有臭味。: A shortage does not make roots smell; a reducing fault does.
常一起出现，都要排水。: They often arrive together. Drain both.
缺素成片按叶位；根腐点片、根先坏。: Nutrient shortage is a sheet by leaf position; root rot is patches, roots first.
旱了土干、全田中午蔫；根腐土常还湿。: Drought is dry soil, the whole field wilting at noon; root rot is often still wet.
总鉴别不分处方；每种元素另有专篇。: A tell-apart page is not a prescription. Each element has its own guide.
病害常点片、有病斑或虫；缺素常成片按叶位。: Disease is often patches, with lesions or insects; shortage is often a sheet by leaf position.
缺钾焦边土不一定白。: Potassium-scorched margins do not always show white crust.
病害点片；旱盐常成片与地形、灌水有关。: Disease is patches; drought and salt often follow the landform and the watering.
粮田目标更高；茶园改到中性会伤树。: Grain land aims higher; taking a tea garden to neutral hurts the bushes.
缺氮老叶黄；过酸是根差叶小。: Nitrogen shortage yellows old leaves; too much acid is poor roots and small leaves.
机械伤是破皮；疮痂是木栓斑。: Machine damage is broken skin; scab is corky spots.
裂皮和水分有关；疮痂是病。: Cracked skin tracks water; scab is a disease.
化肥当季养分；菌剂不替代氮磷钾。: Bag fertiliser is this season’s nutrient; an inoculant does not replace N, P or K.
消毒杀的是一片，包括有益菌。消完要重建。: Sterilising kills a whole community, including the useful ones. Rebuild after.
黄化常见，但根因可能是清耕+高 pH+有机质低。: Yellowing is common, but the root may be clean tillage + high pH + thin organic matter.
旱和瘦常一起，但覆盖能同时改。: Drought and thin often travel together; a cover can change both.
越补越差就是信号，不是肥不够。: Worse after every feed is a signal, not “not enough fertiliser”.
病有，但盐和肥害常一起。: Disease can be there, but salt and fertiliser burn often sit with it.
缺氮老叶匀黄、根还白；酸化先伤根，整株发僵。: Nitrogen shortage: old leaves even yellow, roots still white. Acid soil hurts the roots first and the whole plant stalls.
回暖仍僵、测 pH 低，就不是单纯冷。: Still stalled after a warm spell, and pH is low — that is not chill alone.
缺磷叶暗绿带紫，根不一定褐秃。铝毒先看根尖。: Phosphorus shortage is dark green with purple; roots are not always brown and bare. Aluminium toxicity starts at the root tip.
烧根沿施肥沟、能见肥粒；铝毒是整层酸土。: Root burn lines the fertiliser furrow and you can see grains; aluminium toxicity is the whole acid layer.
脐腐常被当成炭疽打药。先问浇水和 pH。: Blossom-end rot is often sprayed as anthracnose. Ask about watering and pH first.
盐害土面常白霜；缺钙土不一定白。: Salt injury often has white crust; calcium shortage does not need a white surface.
冷害回暖能缓；酸锁磷回暖仍紫。: Chill eases when it warms; acid-locked phosphorus stays purple after a warm spell.
缺氮黄，缺磷常紫暗。: Nitrogen shortage is yellow; phosphorus shortage is often purple-dark.
母质酸和施肥致酸会叠在一起。看施肥账。: Parent-material acid and fertiliser-made acid stack. Read the fertiliser book.
盐害有白霜；致酸是 pH 慢慢掉。: Salt injury has white crust; acidifying is pH creeping down.
粮田区间不能搬进茶园。: A grain-land rate does not move into a tea garden.
过酸那篇才谈要不要改；这篇只谈禁忌。: The too-acid tea guide is the one that asks whether to lift pH. This page is only the don’ts.
盐土 EC 高、pH 不一定很高；碱土 pH 高、钠多。: Salty soil is high EC, pH not always very high; alkali soil is high pH and high sodium.
酸才用石灰；碱土用石灰会更碱。: Lime is for acid; lime on alkali soil makes it more alkali.
滨海多为氯化物盐土，pH 不一定极高。: Coastal fields are often chloride salty soil; pH is not always extremely high.
旱了土干；盐土常有白霜，湿着也蔫。: Drought is dry soil; salty soil often has white crust and still wilts when wet.
肥害刚施肥；微咸水是灌溉史。: Fertiliser burn is a just-applied history; brackish water is an irrigation history.
病害点片；盐害随灌水成片。: Disease is patches; salt injury follows the watering in a sheet.
肥粒可见；返盐是均匀白霜在膜边。: Fertiliser grains are visible; rising salt is an even white crust at the film edge.
药害有喷药史；膜边盐有位置规律。: Spray injury has a spray history; film-edge salt has a place pattern.
缺肥匀黄能出苗；盐地常缺苗。: A shortage yellows evenly and still emerges; salty land often misses plants.
有的玉米小麦不耐盐，换耐盐品种比加肥有用。: Some maize and wheat hate salt. A salt-tolerant variety helps more than another bag.
缺水该灌；洗盐是有灌有排的专门操作。: Dry soil needs a watering; washing salt is a with-in-and-out job of its own.
洗完田边更咸，是盐被赶到那儿，不是肥没化。: After a wash the field edge is saltier — salt was driven there, not undissolved fertiliser.
病重、线虫重，有时要换土或基质；单纯盐先洗。: Heavy disease or nematodes sometimes need new soil or a mix; salt alone is washed first.
越补越差就不是缺。: Worse after every feed is not a shortage.
整层硬是质地或有机质问题；犁底层是下面一条。: The whole layer hard is texture or organic matter; a plough pan is the strip underneath.
旱了浇水能缓；有硬盖是上湿下干或上旱下涝。: Drought eases after water; a hard lid is wet above and dry below, or dry above and wet below.
深松不断层、少乱土层；翻耕把层打乱。: Deep loosening does not smash the layers; ploughing mixes them.
开沟是局部；深松是打破硬盖。: Opening a ditch is local; deep loosening breaks the hard lid.
沙土漏水；粉土雨后浆、干后皮。: Sand leaks water; silt slumps after rain and skins when dry.
盐碱有白霜 pH 高；粉土不一定咸。: Salty-alkali land has white crust and high pH; silt is not always salty.
旱是整田；碾压是两条线。: Drought is the whole field; wheel packing is two lines.
肥害沿施肥沟；碾压沿轮胎。: Fertiliser burn lines the furrow; packing lines the tyre.
深层有墒但根到不了，是路的问题。: There is moisture deeper but the root cannot reach it — that is a road problem.
肥在下面吃不到，不是袋数不够。: Fertiliser underneath that the root cannot eat is not “not enough bags”.
覆盖养结构；深松破硬盖。两件事。: A cover feeds structure; deep loosening breaks the lid. Two jobs.
覆盖能压草，但不是改土的全部。: A cover can hold weeds down, but it is not the whole soil change.
绿肥抢氮就是一种缺氮，原因是微生物先吃饭。: Green manure stealing nitrogen is one kind of nitrogen shortage — microbes eat first.
鲜草过厚局部会沤坏；病害会扩展。: A thick fresh-green layer can rot in spots; disease spreads.
有机肥是肉；生物炭更像骨架。先有肉。: Organic manure is the meat; biochar is more like a skeleton. Meat first.
有的炭偏碱能抬 pH，但不能替代定量石灰。: Some char is alkali and can lift pH, but it does not replace a measured lime rate.
化肥盐分明确；劣质有机肥盐和氨更隐蔽。: Bag fertiliser has a clear salt number; dirty organic manure hides salt and ammonia.
先有房有饭，菌才住。生粪加菌等于热死工人。: A house and a meal first, then the inoculant can live. Raw dung plus inoculant cooks the workers.
病重田秸秆不该还到同科。黄也可能是病。: Badly diseased straw should not go back on the same family. Yellow can also be disease.
还田抢氮是缺氮的一种原因。: Straw stealing nitrogen is one cause of nitrogen shortage.
